{{Top|leg|title=j'ber D'Reb}}
'''J'ber D'Reb''' was a [[Gorothite/Legends|Gorothite]] [[j'ber]]. It was well known that if a Gorothite wanted to transport cargo between [[City/Legends|cities]], then j'ber D'Reb was the best equipped to handle the task.
